### 2. Data Analysis Projects

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| fig-align: center
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Project categories visualization
categories = ['Data Analysis', 'Machine Learning', 'Visualization', 'Web Dev', 'Business Intel']
projects_count = [3, 2, 4, 2, 3]

colors = ['#3498db', '#e74c3c', '#2ecc71', '#f39c12', '#9b59b6']

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))
bars = ax.bar(categories, projects_count, color=colors, edgecolor='white', linewidth=2)

ax.set_ylabel('Number of Projects', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_title('Projects by Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax.set_ylim(0, max(projects_count) + 1)

for bar, count in zip(bars, projects_count):
    ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + 0.1, 
            str(count), ha='center', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
plt.xticks(rotation=15, ha='right')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## 🛠️ Technical Skills Used

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| fig-align: center
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Skills used across projects
skills = ['Python', 'SQL', 'Excel', 'Power BI', 'R', 'Git/GitHub', 'HTML/CSS']
usage = [85, 70, 90, 75, 50, 80, 60]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5))

colors = plt.cm.viridis(np.linspace(0.2, 0.8, len(skills)))
bars = ax.barh(skills, usage, color=colors, edgecolor='white', linewidth=1.5)

ax.set_xlabel('Usage Frequency (%)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_title('Skills Applied Across Projects', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax.set_xlim(0, 100)

for bar, pct in zip(bars, usage):
    ax.text(pct + 2, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'{pct}%', 
            va='center', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
